Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (MAKAUT) for filling up project-based vacancies in West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by MAKAUT?
faq.answer: MAKAUT has advertised vacancies for the Project Associate-I position under the official advertisement number MAKAUT/RE/ADVT./Project Associate-I/104/454.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been released for the Project Associate-I post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for MAKAUT Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 11-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through Email. Candidates need to send their detailed bio-data and necessary documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Microelectronics & VLSI Technology, Embedded System, VLSI Design, EE, AEIE, CSE, EEE, or IT with at least 60% marks or a CGPA of 6.75 and above.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Candidates should check the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or stipend offered for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary ranging between Rs. 25,000 and Rs. 31,000 per month along with HRA as per the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for MAKAUT Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial shortlisting of applications followed by an interview round for the shortlisted eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of MAKAUT?
faq.answer: You can visit the official university website at https://makautwb.ac.in to access all updates, notifications, and further recruitment announcements.
